filing-20260720-5218.quote: large loads’ ability to make use of the new transmission services will be severely limited if new front-of-the-meter generation projects

filing-20260720-5218.quote: Large loads will not be able to transact with new front-of-the-meter resources if resource developers face significant commercial barriers to interconnection

filing-20260715-5011.quote: technical evidence and Xyce netlists and results to assist regional transmission organizations and the Commission in mitigating the infrastructure impacts of large loads

filing-20260715-5011.point: The company says the device offloads reactive power at the load and increases interconnection capacity without new rights-of-way.
filing-20260715-5011.quote: materially increases available interconnection capacity without requiring new transmission rights‑of‑way.

filing-20260709-5023.quote: Where the coordinated-drop magnitude of the block exceeds the loss-of-largest- unit value, the largest credible contingency is no longer a generator

filing-20260709-5023.point: She proposes testing any behaviorally coupled load block at a credible minimum-inertia condition.
filing-20260709-5023.quote: the absorption of any behaviorally-coupled load block must be evaluated at a credible minimum-inertia condition

filing-20260709-5023.quote: the quantity that identifies unaccounted-for load and the quantity that reassigns its cost are the same quantity.

filing-20260708-5103.quote: A 100 MW data center and a 100 MW BESS sit at the same substation on separate meters.

filing-20260708-5103.point: FTM-Netting rests on a telemetry shield, a post-operating-day compliance ledger and scarcity yielding in system-wide emergencies.

filing-20260708-5103.quote: its commercial engine is the private Capacity Attribution Contract (CAC), which bridges the gap between initial non-firm energization and completed network upgrades.

filing-20260708-5103.point: Because the assets are separately metered they stay visible in planning models, unlike behind-the-meter setups.
filing-20260708-5103.quote: they are studied as standard, independent interconnections—fully visible to RTO planning models and subject to existing constraint analyses.

filing-20260708-5018.quote: should be assigned to the loads that cause them, on a cost-causation basis, rather than socialized onto residential and small-commercial ratepayers.
